mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trips (name, region, start_date, end_date, budget, invite_code, status, created_by, user_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{region}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{budget}, #{invite_code}, #{status}, #{created_by}, #{created_by})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, region, start_date, end_date, budget, invite_code, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM trips WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, region, start_date, end_date, budget, invite_code, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM trips ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, name, region, start_date, end_date, budget, invite_code, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM trips WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, name, region, start_date, end_date, budget, invite_code, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM trips WHERE status = 'ongoing' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE trips SET name = #{name}, region = #{region}, start_date = #{start_date}, end_date = #{end_date}, budget = #{budget} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_members (trip_id, user_id, display_name, short_name, color_code, role) VALUES (#{trip_id}, #{user_id}, #{display_name}, #{short_name}, #{color_code}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, trip_id, user_id, display_name, short_name, color_code, role, joined_at FROM trip_members WHERE trip_id = #{trip_id} ORDER BY joined_at ASC
